research.title: Calibration Evaluation for Regularized Classifiers
bullets: Implemented assigned routines for fitting regularized logistic regression models and generating reliability diagrams under a predefined evaluation protocol.
Checked probability binning against hand calculated examples and summarized calibration patterns across validation splits for group review.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate supervisor.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained organized inventory records, and coordinated routine pickup schedules with staff and delivery personnel.

projects.title: Baseline Methods for Tabular Regression
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines with training set standardization for a tabular prediction task.
Selected regularization settings through cross validation and inspected held out residuals for systematic errors across target value ranges.
